implemented_subset.failure_forms: Lifecycle methods return Result<DocumentInfo> with input/context/idempotency/schema/storage diagnostics. NastranCodec returns ImportOutcome/ExportOutcome: optional candidate/artifact plus complete/report/issues, rather than unconditional success. Storage ports can throw StorageError(uncertain); codec failure never implies safe file publication.

state_failure_version_rules: Reference evidence remains L1_draft. This file documents actual public declarations separately from design names; no fresh consumer/BP execution, L2 or full SK/P0 acceptance is asserted.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Design/acceptance obligation: Normal open, fault recovery, explicit save, save-as and discard have distinct identity/durability behavior.
Design/acceptance obligation: Duplicate export/import numbers or unsupported semantics reject; original revision/model remain intact.
Design/acceptance obligation: Save replacement failure/retry verifies target token before overwrite and before saved marker publication.
Design/acceptance obligation: Legacy schemas require frozen pre-refactor fixtures; unknown/corrupt schema never activates an editable empty model.
